description: Config + auto-running migration runner + the complete unified data-model migrations. Extends backend/src/config/env.js with the Step-1 env surface; adds src/db/migrationRunner.js that reuses PgDatabase.pool, tracks a schema_migrations table, and applies numbered backend/db/migrations/*.sql in order inside transactions idempotently; wires startup migrations into src/server.js (gated to real Postgres only); authors every table in the plan's 'Mô hình dữ liệu' section as numbered migrations incl. pgvector extension, material_chunk/question embedding vector(1024) + HNSW index, and the legacy question.status data-migration (Active->APPROVED, Draft->DRAFT) with a relaxed status CHECK. Updates schema.sql as human-facing reference. This is the foundation FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 build on; it must leave the build green with no Docker.
steps: Read backend/src/config/env.js, backend/src/db/createDatabase.js, backend/src/db/mapDbError.js, backend/src/app.js, backend/src/server.js, backend/db/schema.sql, backend/db/migrations/002_rubric_criterion.sql FIRST (context.json lists them).

Extend backend/src/config/env.js: add keys via process.env + the existing readBoolean helper — dynamodbEndpoint (DYNAMODB_ENDPOINT), s3Endpoint (S3_ENDPOINT), lambdaEndpoint (LAMBDA_ENDPOINT), smtpHost/smtpPort/smtpUser, appBaseUrl (APP_BASE_URL default http://localhost:8080), bedrockModelId (BEDROCK_MODEL_ID), bedrockEmbedModelId (BEDROCK_EMBED_MODEL_ID), jwtSecret (JWT_SECRET), materialsBucket (MATERIALS_BUCKET_NAME), jobQueueConcurrency (JOB_QUEUE_CONCURRENCY default 2), jobQueuePollIntervalMs (JOB_QUEUE_POLL_INTERVAL_MS default 1000), jobMaxAttempts (JOB_MAX_ATTEMPTS default 3), migrationsDir (MIGRATIONS_DIR default path.resolve(__dirname,'..','..','db','migrations')). Keep ALL existing keys. No 'if (local)' branches.

Create backend/db/migrations/001_baseline.sql: idempotent CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mirroring current schema.sql (topic, rubric, rubric_criterion, question with the OLD status CHECK IN ('Active','Draft')) plus the two unique indexes, so the runner alone can build an empty DB.

Create backend/src/db/migrationRunner.js exporting runMigrations({ pool, dir, logger }) and pure helpers orderMigrationFiles(filenames) (numeric-prefix ascending: 001<002<010) and pendingMigrations(allVersions, appliedVersions). runMigrations: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS schema_migrations(version TEXT PRIMARY KEY, applied_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()); read *.sql from dir; for each pending version acquire a client from pool, BEGIN, run the file SQL, INSERT the version, COMMIT (ROLLBACK on error, rethrow). Idempotent on re-run.

Edit backend/src/server.js: before app.listen, when !env.dbMockMode, create the db via createDatabase(env); if it is a PgDatabase (has .pool) await runMigrations({ pool: db.pool, dir: env.migrationsDir, logger }); pass the same db into createApp({ database: db }) so no second pool is created; on migration failure log and process.exit(1). In mock mode skip migrations and keep current behavior. Do NOT modify createApp in app.js.
Create backend/db/migrations/003_extensions.sql: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;

Create backend/db/migrations/004_accounts.sql: app_user (code UNIQUE, email UNIQUE, full_name, password_hash, role CHECK ADMIN/LECTURER/STUDENT, status CHECK ACTIVE/LOCKED default ACTIVE, failed_login_count, locked_until, last_login_at), auth_session (user_id FK, refresh_token_hash, expires_at, revoked_at, ip, user_agent), password_token (user_id FK, token_hash, purpose CHECK SET/RESET, expires_at, used_at).

Create backend/db/migrations/005_subjects.sql: subject (code UNIQUE, name), subject_lecturer (subject_id FK, lecturer_id FK app_user, UNIQUE pair), ALTER TABLE topic ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS subject_id INTEGER REFERENCES subject(subject_id).

Create backend/db/migrations/006_materials.sql (after 003 & 005): course_material (subject_id FK, topic_id FK, title, file_key, mime_type, size_bytes, page_count, status CHECK UPLOADED/PROCESSING/READY/FAILED default UPLOADED, error, uploaded_by FK app_user), material_chunk (material_id FK ON DELETE CASCADE, chunk_no, location, content, embedding vector(1024)) + CREATE INDEX USING hnsw (embedding vector_cosine_ops).

Create backend/db/migrations/007_questions_rubrics.sql (after 003 & 005): ALTER rubric ADD subject_id FK, is_locked default false, version default 1, created_by FK app_user; performance_level (criterion_id FK rubric_criterion ON DELETE CASCADE, label, min_score, max_score, description, order_no); question_generation_job (topic_id FK, material_ids JSONB, requested_count, bloom_distribution JSONB, language, status, generated_count default 0, error, requested_by FK app_user); ALTER question ADD bloom_level CHECK REMEMBER/UNDERSTAND/APPLY/ANALYZE, language, reference_answer, key_points JSONB, source CHECK MANUAL/IMPORT/AI, rationale JSONB, embedding vector(1024), generation_job_id FK question_generation_job, created_by/reviewed_by FK app_user, reviewed_at, review_note; THEN data-migration UPDATE question SET status='APPROVED' WHERE status='Active'; UPDATE question SET status='DRAFT' WHERE status='Draft'; THEN DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS chk_question_status and ADD CONSTRAINT chk_question_status CHECK (status IN ('DRAFT','PENDING_REVIEW','APPROVED','REJECTED','ARCHIVED')); question_source_ref (question_id FK question ON DELETE CASCADE, chunk_id FK material_chunk, excerpt).

Create backend/db/migrations/008_exam_viva.sql (after 005 & 007): exam_session (subject_id FK, topic_id FK, title, language CHECK VI/EN, main_question_count, max_follow_ups_per_question, answer_time_limit_sec, think_time_sec, opens_at, closes_at, status CHECK DRAFT/OPEN/CLOSED default DRAFT, created_by FK app_user); exam_session_student (exam_session_id FK, student_id FK app_user, UNIQUE pair); exam_session_examiner (exam_session_id FK, lecturer_id FK app_user); viva_interview (exam_session_id FK, student_id FK, status CHECK NOT_STARTED/IN_PROGRESS/PAUSED/COMPLETED/TERMINATED default NOT_STARTED, current_question_index default 0, current_follow_up_count default 0, started_at, deadline_at, ended_at, end_reason, client_ip); assigned_question (interview_id FK, question_id FK, order_no, is_asked default false); qa_turn (interview_id FK, assigned_question_id FK, sequence_no, turn_type CHECK MAIN/FOLLOW_UP, follow_up_reason, question_text, rationale JSONB, answer_text, answer_audio_key, transcript_confidence, asked_at, answer_started_at, answer_ended_at, timed_out, status, response_latency_ms, speech_duration_ms, words_per_minute, pause_count); transcript (interview_id FK, full_text, is_complete default false); processing_failure (interview_id FK, turn_id FK qa_turn, stage, error_code, message, retry_count default 0, resolved default false).

Create backend/db/migrations/009_scoring.sql (after 008 & 007): viva_result (interview_id FK UNIQUE, status CHECK PENDING/AI_SCORING/AI_SUGGESTED/FLAGGED/FINALIZED default PENDING, ai_total_score, final_total_score, finalized_by FK app_user, finalized_at); question_evaluation (result_id FK viva_result ON DELETE CASCADE, assigned_question_id FK assigned_question, ai_score, final_score, confidence, strengths, weaknesses, missing_points JSONB, feedback, flag_reason, model_id, prompt_version); criterion_score (evaluation_id FK question_evaluation ON DELETE CASCADE, criterion_id FK rubric_criterion, ai_level_id FK performance_level, ai_score, ai_justification, evidence JSONB, final_score); score_adjustment (criterion_score_id FK criterion_score ON DELETE CASCADE, old_score, new_score, reason, adjusted_by FK app_user, adjusted_at default now()).

Create backend/db/migrations/010_background_job.sql: background_job (type CHECK INGEST_MATERIAL/GENERATE_QUESTIONS/GRADE_INTERVIEW/SEND_EMAIL, payload JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', status CHECK PENDING/RUNNING/DONE/FAILED default PENDING, attempts int default 0, max_attempts int, run_after timestamptz default now(), locked_at, last_error, created_at default now(), updated_at default now()) + CREATE INDEX ON background_job (status, run_after).

Update backend/db/schema.sql to reflect the final model (new question status CHECK + all new tables) with a header note that migrations in backend/db/migrations are the source of truth. Keep existing minimal tables consistent.

Add backend/test/migrationRunnerService.test.js (node:test) covering orderMigrationFiles ordering (001<002<010) and pendingMigrations filtering. Run cd backend; npm test and confirm all node:test files pass without Docker and existing *Service.test.js are unaffected.
acceptance_criteria: cd backend && npm test passes with no Docker, including the new test/migrationRunnerService.test.js, and existing questionService/rubricService/audioWorkflowService tests still pass.
cd backend && npm run test:e2e still passes with no Docker (existing crud.e2e/workflow.e2e unaffected; no new always-on Postgres dependency introduced by this FEAT).
backend/src/db/migrationRunner.js exports runMigrations, orderMigrationFiles, pendingMigrations and uses the pool passed in (reuses PgDatabase.pool, no second Pool).

backend/db/migrations contains 001_baseline.sql, 003_extensions.sql, 004_accounts.sql, 005_subjects.sql, 006_materials.sql, 007_questions_rubrics.sql, 008_exam_viva.sql, 009_scoring.sql, 010_background_job.sql; 002_rubric_criterion.sql is unchanged; every table from the plan's data model is present with its key columns; question status data-migration and relaxed CHECK are in 007.
backend/src/server.js runs migrations at startup only when !env.dbMockMode and only against a PgDatabase; createApp in app.js is unchanged; env.js keeps all prior keys plus the new ones.
verification: If Docker is available: docker compose up -d postgres (after FEAT-003 compose exists) then TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgres://aives:aives@localhost:5432/aives npm run test:e2e to confirm migrations apply on pgvector/pgvector:pg16 — otherwise defer this to FEAT-003's gated e2e.
findings:
DONE. Verification: `cd backend; npm test` -> 19/19 node:test pass (incl. 4 new migrationRunner tests). `cd backend; npm run test:e2e` -> all 74 Jest e2e tests (crud.e2e + workflow.e2e) PASS with no Docker, confirmed via `jest --runInBand --testMatch "**/test/**/*.e2e.test.js"`. NOTE for FEAT-002/003: the plain `npm run test:e2e` exits 1 ONLY inside this `.worktrees/...` dir because jest.config.js uses `testMatch: ['<rootDir>/test/**/*.e2e.test.js']` and micromatch refuses to traverse the dot-prefixed `.worktrees` path segment. In the normal checkout (merge target has no leading-dot path segments) the same config discovers both suites correctly (verified against the main workspace backend). jest.config.js was intentionally NOT changed to avoid altering normal-checkout behavior.

MIGRATION RUNNER (backend/src/db/migrationRunner.js) exports: runMigrations({ pool, dir, logger }) (async; reuses the passed-in pool, no new Pool), orderMigrationFiles(filenames) (numeric-prefix ascending, drops non NNN_*.sql), pendingMigrations(allVersions, appliedVersions). Tracks applied versions in table schema_migrations(version TEXT PK, applied_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()). Each pending file runs in its own BEGIN/COMMIT (ROLLBACK+rethrow on error). Version string = the leading numeric prefix as text (e.g. '001','002','010'). server.js runs it at startup only when !env.dbMockMode and only when the db has a .pool (PgDatabase); on failure logs via pino and process.exit(1). createApp in app.js is UNCHANGED (migrations never run inside createApp).

NEW ENV KEYS in backend/src/config/env.js (all existing keys kept): dynamodbEndpoint (DYNAMODB_ENDPOINT), s3Endpoint (S3_ENDPOINT), lambdaEndpoint (LAMBDA_ENDPOINT), smtpHost (SMTP_HOST), smtpPort (SMTP_PORT, default 1025), smtpUser (SMTP_USER), appBaseUrl (APP_BASE_URL, default http://localhost:8080), bedrockModelId (BEDROCK_MODEL_ID), bedrockEmbedModelId (BEDROCK_EMBED_MODEL_ID), jwtSecret (JWT_SECRET), materialsBucket (MATERIALS_BUCKET_NAME, default local-materials-bucket), jobQueueConcurrency (JOB_QUEUE_CONCURRENCY, default 2), jobQueuePollIntervalMs (JOB_QUEUE_POLL_INTERVAL_MS, default 1000), jobMaxAttempts (JOB_MAX_ATTEMPTS, default 3), migrationsDir (MIGRATIONS_DIR, default <backend>/db/migrations).

MIGRATIONS present: 001_baseline.sql (topic, rubric, question with OLD status CHECK; uq_question_content_normalized), 002_rubric_criterion.sql (unchanged: rubric.max_score + rubric_criterion + uq_rubric_criterion_name), 003_extensions.sql (CREATE EXTENSION vector), 004_accounts.sql, 005_subjects.sql, 006_materials.sql, 007_questions_rubrics.sql (status data-migration Active->APPROVED/Draft->DRAFT + relaxed chk_question_status), 008_exam_viva.sql, 009_scoring.sql, 010_background_job.sql.

EXACT TABLES + PK/key columns (all PKs are <table>_id SERIAL unless noted):
- app_user: app_user_id; code UNIQUE, email UNIQUE NOT NULL, full_name, password_hash, role CHECK(ADMIN/LECTURER/STUDENT), status CHECK(ACTIVE/LOCKED) DEFAULT ACTIVE, failed_login_count DEFAULT 0, locked_until, last_login_at, created_at.
- auth_session: auth_session_id; user_id FK app_user ON DELETE CASCADE, refresh_token_hash, expires_at, revoked_at, ip, user_agent, created_at.
- password_token: password_token_id; user_id FK app_user, token_hash, purpose CHECK(SET/RESET), expires_at, used_at, created_at.
- subject: subject_id; code UNIQUE NOT NULL, name NOT NULL.
- subject_lecturer: subject_lecturer_id; subject_id FK, lecturer_id FK app_user, UNIQUE(subject_id,lecturer_id) = uq_subject_lecturer.
- topic: topic_id; name, subject_id FK subject (added in 005).
- course_material: course_material_id; subject_id FK, topic_id FK, title, file_key, mime_type, size_bytes BIGINT, page_count, status CHECK(UPLOADED/PROCESSING/READY/FAILED) DEFAULT UPLOADED, error, uploaded_by FK app_user, created_at.
- material_chunk: material_chunk_id; material_id FK course_material ON DELETE CASCADE, chunk_no, location, content, embedding vector(1024); HNSW index idx_material_chunk_embedding (vector_cosine_ops).
- rubric: rubric_id; max_score, subject_id FK, is_locked DEFAULT false, version DEFAULT 1, created_by FK app_user.
- rubric_criterion: rubric_criterion_id; rubric_id FK ON DELETE CASCADE, criterion_name, weight_percent, description; uq_rubric_criterion_name.
- performance_level: performance_level_id; criterion_id FK rubric_criterion ON DELETE CASCADE, label, min_score, max_score, description, order_no.
- question_generation_job: question_generation_job_id; topic_id FK, material_ids JSONB, requested_count, bloom_distribution JSONB, language, status, generated_count DEFAULT 0, error, requested_by FK app_user, created_at.
- question: question_id; topic_id FK NOT NULL, rubric_id FK, content, status CHECK(DRAFT/PENDING_REVIEW/APPROVED/REJECTED/ARCHIVED), bloom_level CHECK(REMEMBER/UNDERSTAND/APPLY/ANALYZE or NULL), language, reference_answer, key_points JSONB, source CHECK(MANUAL/IMPORT/AI or NULL), rationale JSONB, embedding vector(1024), generation_job_id FK, created_by FK, reviewed_by FK, reviewed_at, review_note; uq_question_content_normalized.
- question_source_ref: question_source_ref_id; question_id FK question ON DELETE CASCADE, chunk_id FK material_chunk, excerpt.
- exam_session: exam_session_id; subject_id FK, topic_id FK, title, language CHECK(VI/EN), main_question_count, max_follow_ups_per_question, answer_time_limit_sec, think_time_sec, opens_at, closes_at, status CHECK(DRAFT/OPEN/CLOSED) DEFAULT DRAFT, created_by FK, created_at.
- exam_session_student: exam_session_student_id; exam_session_id FK ON DELETE CASCADE, student_id FK app_user, UNIQUE(exam_session_id,student_id)=uq_exam_session_student.
- exam_session_examiner: exam_session_examiner_id; exam_session_id FK ON DELETE CASCADE, lecturer_id FK app_user.
- viva_interview: viva_interview_id; exam_session_id FK ON DELETE CASCADE, student_id FK, status CHECK(NOT_STARTED/IN_PROGRESS/PAUSED/COMPLETED/TERMINATED) DEFAULT NOT_STARTED, current_question_index DEFAULT 0, current_follow_up_count DEFAULT 0, started_at, deadline_at, ended_at, end_reason, client_ip.
- assigned_question: assigned_question_id; interview_id FK viva_interview ON DELETE CASCADE, question_id FK question, order_no, is_asked DEFAULT false.
- qa_turn: qa_turn_id; interview_id FK ON DELETE CASCADE, assigned_question_id FK assigned_question, sequence_no, turn_type CHECK(MAIN/FOLLOW_UP), follow_up_reason, question_text, rationale JSONB, answer_text, answer_audio_key, transcript_confidence, asked_at, answer_started_at, answer_ended_at, timed_out, status, response_latency_ms, speech_duration_ms, words_per_minute, pause_count.
- transcript: transcript_id; interview_id FK ON DELETE CASCADE, full_text, is_complete DEFAULT false.
- processing_failure: processing_failure_id; interview_id FK ON DELETE CASCADE, turn_id FK qa_turn, stage, error_code, message, retry_count DEFAULT 0, resolved DEFAULT false.
- viva_result: viva_result_id; interview_id FK viva_interview UNIQUE ON DELETE CASCADE, status CHECK(PENDING/AI_SCORING/AI_SUGGESTED/FLAGGED/FINALIZED) DEFAULT PENDING, ai_total_score, final_total_score, finalized_by FK app_user, finalized_at.
- question_evaluation: question_evaluation_id; result_id FK viva_result ON DELETE CASCADE, assigned_question_id FK assigned_question, ai_score, final_score, confidence, strengths, weaknesses, missing_points JSONB, feedback, flag_reason, model_id, prompt_version.
- criterion_score: criterion_score_id; evaluation_id FK question_evaluation ON DELETE CASCADE, criterion_id FK rubric_criterion, ai_level_id FK performance_level, ai_score, ai_justification, evidence JSONB, final_score.
- score_adjustment: score_adjustment_id; criterion_score_id FK criterion_score ON DELETE CASCADE, old_score, new_score, reason, adjusted_by FK app_user, adjusted_at DEFAULT now().
- background_job: background_job_id; type CHECK(INGEST_MATERIAL/GENERATE_QUESTIONS/GRADE_INTERVIEW/SEND_EMAIL), payload JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', status CHECK(PENDING/RUNNING/DONE/FAILED) DEFAULT PENDING, attempts DEFAULT 0, max_attempts, run_after DEFAULT now(), locked_at, last_error, created_at, updated_at; index idx_background_job_status_run_after (status, run_after).
